display_long_description:
Step into Archery Simulator: Target Shooting and test your aim across 50 handcrafted VR archery levels built for precision, timing, and satisfying bow-and-arrow gameplay.

Hold the bow in one hand, grab and nock arrows with the other, pull the string, judge distance and wind, then release naturally to hit the target. Every level introduces a new challenge, from longer shots and moving targets to limited-arrow objectives, timed stages, score goals, and special missions.

Take on:
• Target shooting across forests, islands, stadiums, rocky ranges, and city environments
• Moving and animated targets that demand accuracy and quick reactions
• Wind and distance challenges that make every shot matter
• Limited-arrow missions with a visible physical arrow rack
• Rescue objectives, locks, balloons, fire and water targets, ice, lava hazards, and helicopter challenges
• 1–3 star ratings, best scores, coins, trophies, retries, and progressive level unlocking
• Practice mode with unlimited arrows for relaxed bow training

Designed for comfortable VR play, every stage keeps you at a carefully positioned shooting point with no forced locomotion. The bright stylized art, readable targets, and arcade presentation make it easy to pick up, while tougher levels reward consistency and mastery.

Perfect for fans of archery, target shooting, bow and arrow games, precision challenges, sports games, and VR simulators.
